BiblicalUsage: Parshandatha is one of the ten sons of Haman, named in Esther 9:7 among the sons slain in Shushan after Haman's plot against the Jews was turned back on his own house. His name stands beside his brothers in the list, and the judgment on Haman's house is told in the names of his sons.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the list of their names is the record of a judgment finished in one day, and no son of Haman was left to carry the plot on.
